analysis_status: robustness audit designed after observing the current-opportunity axis asymmetry; not confirmatory

procedure.plant_omission: remove all dyad-transition rows involving one plant species from both training and held-out sets, then rerun the same three-model leave-one-transition-out audit
procedure.pollinator_omission: remove all dyad-transition rows involving one pollinator species from both training and held-out sets, then rerun the same three-model leave-one-transition-out audit
procedure.preprocessing: log1p then training-fold z-score, identical to the parent axis audit
procedure.gain_contrast: pollinator activity increment minus plant availability increment
procedure.loss_contrast: plant availability increment minus pollinator activity increment

success_rule: report the fraction and range of leave-one-species-out contrasts; do not infer independence from species identity unless every omission preserves the declared sign

interpretation.allowed: the post-hoc axis asymmetry is or is not dominated by any single plant or pollinator species in the primary scope

claim_ceiling: Species-leverage robustness only. Preserving the sign under every single-species omission rules out domination by one plant or pollinator species, but does not convert the post-result predictive asymmetry into a causal or confirmatory ecological mechanism.
